key_insight: An asymmetrically threaded SQUID (ATS) coupler enables fast entangling gates between Kerr-cat qubits while preserving their protection against bit-flip errors.
engineering_relevance: The design offers a potential building block for fault-tolerant cat-qubit architectures without requiring complex pulse shaping.
method: Use an ATS parametric coupler to mediate a bias-preserving CX gate.
Engineer unequal photon numbers in control and target modes to suppress non-adiabatic leakage.
Evaluate gate performance through full circuit-Hamiltonian simulations.
evidence_signal: Simulations report 99.69% CX fidelity in 50 ns without photon loss; at a single-photon loss rate of 100 kHz, the noise bias reaches 9922, approximately 570× that of a naive non-bias-preserving CX.
watch_item: The results are numerical rather than experimental, and the quoted 99.69% fidelity excludes photon loss.
paper_title: Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
